panels.title: Scrape target availability
panels.description: 1 means Prometheus can scrape the target. Service health and overload are separate signals.

panels.title: Admission limit and configured bounds
panels.description: Active work can temporarily exceed a reduced limit while draining.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by(instance,service) (rate(gatewise_requests_rejected_total{service=~"$service",instance=~"$instance",job="gatewise"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by(instance,service) (rate(gatewise_requests_rejected_total{service=~"$service",instance=~"$instance",job="gatewise"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by(instance,service) (rate(gatewise_requests_admitted_total{service=~"$service",instance=~"$instance",job="gatewise"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Admitted completed work — p95 latency
panels.description: Admission rejections and canceled/panicked work are excluded; HTTP errors returned by handlers remain included.

panels.title: Service mode
panels.description: A constant 1 identifies the configured fixed/adaptive mode.

panels.title: Controller completed-window samples
panels.description: Samples in the last evaluated window; zero before evaluation.

panels.title: Controller normalized p90 latency
panels.description: Bucket-estimated handler duration / route budget. A value above 1 indicates latency pressure.

panels.title: Controller failure fraction
panels.description: 5xx and panic fraction among contributing samples; cancellations excluded.

panels.title: Controller last decision
panels.description: Value 1 identifies the last decision and bounded reason, including hold and not_evaluated.

panels.title: Controller evaluation age
panels.description: Age of the last completed window. Idle traffic can legitimately leave an old window.

panels.title: Controller observed saturation
panels.description: Whether total or background capacity was reached during the last evaluated window.
